title: slots.shimme.rs
description: The play-money casino's economy, games, players and what goes on beside the tables, from the numbers the slots server pushes into VictoriaMetrics (src/metrics.rs).

panels.title: Coins held by everyone
panels.description: All players' balances together, as of the last five minutes, with how it got there.

panels.title: Jackpot
panels.description: The shared pot. A round takes it with probability XP x 1.25% / the pot, so it has no cap.

panels.title: Players today
panels.description: Signed in or played in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Playing now
panels.description: Browser tabs open on the site right now.

panels.title: Site
panels.description: https://slots.shimme.rs/healthz, as the status probe sees it.

panels.title: Rounds played
panels.description: In the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Coins wagered
panels.description: In the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: House take
panels.description: Wagered less paid out, jackpots included. Below zero the players are ahead.

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time(slots_wagered_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) - ((sum(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(sum_over_time(slots_jackpot_paid_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Paid back
panels.description: Paid out over wagered: the return players really got from the games in the time range.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(sum_over_time(slots_jackpot_paid_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) / (sum(sum_over_time(slots_wagered_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Coins handed out
panels.description: Every reward, the daily wheel and refills; not the welcome balance, and not made smaller by what was spent.

panels.title: All-in return
panels.description: Wins, jackpots and gifts together over what was wagered. Above 100% the players got back more than they staked, gifts included: coins pile up. Gifts are not filtered by game.

targets.expr: (((sum(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(sum_over_time(slots_jackpot_paid_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) + (sum(sum_over_time(slots_gift_coins{kind!="welcome"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) / (sum(sum_over_time(slots_wagered_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Coins spent
panels.description: What players paid in the back room and the shop: coins that left for good.

panels.title: Jackpots won
panels.description: In the dashboard's time range.

options.content: Coins enter as **gifts** (welcome balance, wheel, rewards) and as **wins**; they leave as **stakes** and as what is **spent** in the back room and the shop. Green goes to players, red to the house, purple is handed out, brown is spent.

panels.title: Coins held by everyone
panels.description: Every coin comes from a gift, a round or a gamble; the history is worked back from today's balances, from the first round on.

panels.title: Coins in and out
panels.description: What moved in each step: stakes and what was spent below the line, everything that reached the players above it.

panels.title: Where gifts come from
panels.description: Coins handed out in the time range, by kind.

panels.title: House take against gifts
panels.description: When purple outgrows red and brown together, coins pile up in the players' balances.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(slots_wagered_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval)) - (sum(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)) - (sum(sum_over_time(slots_jackpot_paid_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval)) or vector(0))

panels.title: Return to players, over the last 24 hours
panels.description: Paid out over wagered in the day up to each moment, by the games alone and with the gifts of that day on top. In the shaded part the players were ahead that day.

panels.title: Gifts, by how often they come
panels.description: Gifts a player gets once dry up as everyone has reached them; the ones that grow with play are a share of the house's edge; the rest come round with the calendar whether anyone stakes much or not. The last two are what the economy lives with.

properties.value: With play: levels, loss-back, lucky hour
Every day: wheel, missions, seed, tournament, chest

panels.title: Where coins are spent
panels.description: Coins paid in the time range for machine levels, spots and safes in the back room, and for what the shop sells.

panels.title: The bank
panels.description: Coins players put out of play: they leave the balances (and Coins held by everyone) while they are in, and come out no sooner than the next day. Neither a gift nor spending. When it only climbs, players are saving wins instead of staking them again.

options.content: Every game keeps its colour on every panel. Figures are for the dashboard's time range unless a panel says otherwise.

panels.title: Game by game
panels.description: Paid back is green below 100% and turns orange and red as players come out ahead; read it against the rounds beside it, since a handful of rounds swings wildly. Without jackpots is what the game itself paid. Small rounds are those staked under 1,000 coins, too small to count towards the rewards that count rounds.

targets.expr: sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) + (sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_jackpot_paid_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) * 0)

(sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) + (sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_jackpot_paid_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) * 0)) / sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_wagered_coins{game=~"$game"}[$__range]))

(sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_small_rounds{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) or sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_rounds{game=~"$game"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_rounds{game=~"$game"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Paid back since the very start
panels.description: Every round ever played on each game: what it paid back with the jackpots that fell on it, and what the game alone paid. The fewer the rounds, the less either figure says.

panels.title: Big wins
panels.description: Rounds that paid 10 times the bet or more, by game.

panels.title: Small rounds by game
panels.description: Rounds staked under 1,000 coins. A wall of them on one game is somebody counting rounds, not playing: they earn no rank, goal or season points.

options.content: Balances, levels and stickers are recorded from when the dashboard was set up; rounds and who played go back to the first round.

panels.title: Players each day
panels.description: Distinct players with at least one round in each day.

panels.title: Up or down in the time range
panels.description: What each player's rounds paid them less what they staked.

panels.title: Players on each level
panels.description: How many players have reached each level.

panels.title: How it is used: autoplay, visits, screens opened

options.content: From src/usage.rs: whether a round came from autoplay (known from 27 November 2026 on; every round before counts as by hand), visits (from the first round or screen to half an hour without either, counted when they end), and the dialogs, tabs and games players open. Hide players leaves out whoever is picked wherever a panel knows who played.

panels.title: Rounds by hand and by autoplay
Autoplay's share, by game
panels.description: Of the rounds in the time range, how many autoplay started. A game played mostly by autoplay is being farmed, not enjoyed.

panels.title: Rounds by game, of those shown
panels.description: Rounds by game counted from each player's own, so that hidden players are left out.

panels.title: Visits
panels.description: Visits that ended in the time range.

panels.title: Visits without a round
panels.description: Came, looked around, played nothing.

panels.title: Visiting now
panels.description: Players with a round or a screen opened in the last half hour.

panels.title: First visit
panels.description: How long new players stayed the first time, on average, for first visits that ended in the time range.

panels.title: Visits by length
panels.description: Every visit, counted when it ended, by how long it lasted.

panels.title: Screens opened
panels.description: Dialogs (by title), tabs (rewards_*, backroom_*) and games (game.*) players opened in the time range; app.open is a page load, app.lobby a return to the lobby.

panels.title: Visits by player
panels.description: First visit shows only for a player whose first visit ended in the time range.

panels.title: Where each player plays
panels.description: Rounds by player and game, the 30 biggest. Counted rounds (from 1,000 coins) and autoplay are in the next two.

panels.title: Counted rounds by player and game
Autoplay rounds by player and game
Notifications: who asked for what, and what came of it

options.content: From src/push.rs: the devices players turned notifications on for, what was to be told and what came of it (sent; failed when no device took it; or held back because the kind was off, the site was open, the player paused or hit their daily cap), and the taps on them. What quiet hours put off is not counted until it goes out.

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Browsers and phones that take notifications.

panels.title: Players
panels.description: Players with at least one such device.

panels.title: Sent
panels.description: Notifications that reached at least one device in the time range.

panels.title: Tapped
panels.description: Taps for every notification sent, in the time range.

panels.title: Failed devices
panels.description: Deliveries a push service refused, or that never got there. A device the service says is gone is dropped.

panels.title: What came of them
panels.description: active: the site was open, so it showed in the page. off: the player switched the kind off. capped: over their daily cap. paused: they paused all.

panels.title: Switched from the default
panels.description: Players who switched a kind off that is on by default (off), or on that is off by default (on). A kind many switch off is one nobody wants.

panels.title: Quiet hours off
panels.description: Players who want notifications at night too.

panels.title: Cap changed
panels.description: Players who picked another daily cap than 4.

panels.title: Clips and shared links
panels.description: Replays passed on: clip_video and clip_gif are clips made, clip_share one sent through the phone's share sheet, clip_download one saved, link_copy a replay link copied, shared_visit someone arriving through such a link.

panels.title: Stills for link previews
panels.description: Replays with a still: the picture Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram and X show beside the link. The first clip of a replay leaves it.

panels.title: Link previews served
panels.description: A replay's link opened without a session, in the time range: the services that draw previews, and friends not signed in yet. Counted since the server last started.

panels.title: Beside the tables: tokens, the back room, the shop, the events

options.content: **Tokens** are earned by the back room and by taking part, and are never coins; violet is tokens. The counts below are how things stand, read every five minutes, from the day these features went live.

panels.title: Tokens held
panels.description: All players' tokens together.

panels.title: Tokens earned
panels.description: In the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Tokens spent
panels.description: On the back room's chest and in the shop, in the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Machines earning
panels.description: Machines standing on back room floors right now.

panels.title: Bought in the shop
panels.description: Cosmetics owned, for coins or tokens, by everyone together.

panels.title: Prestige stars
panels.description: Stars held by everyone together.

panels.title: Tokens earned and spent
panels.description: Earned above the line, by what for; spent below it.

panels.title: Where tokens come from
panels.description: Tokens earned in the time range, by kind.

panels.title: Tokens held by everyone
panels.description: When this only climbs, there is too little to spend tokens on.

panels.title: Back rooms
panels.description: What players have built with coins. A machine starts on level 1, so levels above the number of machines are levels that were bought.

panels.title: Runner, chests and tips
panels.description: The day's counts start again at midnight, the server's time.

panels.title: Machines on the floors
panels.description: Which games stand in back rooms right now.

panels.title: Coins from the back room
panels.description: The machines take coins by the hour into the safe (at most 12,500 a floor), and the day's chest grows with the floor. None of it grows with betting. What was collected is under Where coins come from, as Back room takings.

panels.title: High rollers
panels.description: Floors a high roller visits today, the ones there now and not met yet, and the visits met. A visit lasts two hours; one not met is gone.

panels.title: Back room takings by game
panels.description: What the machines of each game take in coins an hour across all floors, before each floor's cap.

panels.title: Shop sales
panels.description: Cosmetics sold in each step. What they cost is under Where coins are spent and Tokens earned and spent.

panels.title: What the shop has sold
panels.description: How many players own each thing. What nobody owns is not listed: too dear, or not wanted.

panels.title: Daily seed and tournament
panels.description: How many turn up. The seed's count starts again at midnight; the tournament's stands until the next one begins.

panels.title: Shared goal
panels.description: The week's meter against what it asks for: a tenth more than the week before managed, at least 1,500 and at most 10,000 rounds for each player then. Only rounds staked 1,000 coins or more count. Reached early every week, the target is too low.

panels.title: Goal chests and bounties
panels.description: This week's. Bounties that are never taken ask for too much; ones gone on Monday ask for too little.

panels.title: Season: how far players have claimed
panels.description: Players by the highest tier of the season's track they have claimed.

panels.title: Mastery: ranks paid by game
panels.description: Players paid for each rank on each game. Above Bronze a rank takes the game's feats (a big win, so many good wins), not rounds alone: games that stop at Bronze are ground at, not enjoyed.

panels.title: The shop's weekly rotation
panels.description: Three token-priced things are in the shop each week and leave on Monday. Sales that jump on Mondays mean the rotation is what gets tokens spent.

panels.title: Crafting the missing ones
panels.description: Pages a sticker short are what crafting is for: when they stay high while dust piles up, crafting costs too much or is not found.

panels.title: Sticker trades
panels.description: Every offer ever made, by how it ended; open ones are waiting.

panels.title: First steps: how far new players get
panels.description: New players on the three first steps. A step many reach and few claim is not seen; a chest that waits and is never opened is a player who did not come back.

panels.title: Game of the day
panels.description: The quiet game picked each day, with tokens for playing it. If its rounds do not rise above what the game gets on other days, the tokens are not worth the trip.

panels.title: Playing together
panels.description: Reactions on the feed's wins, records taken from someone else, and how often the feed, the weekly boards and the ghosts were opened (ghosts_passed: a run past yesterday's best). The opens count from the server's last start.

panels.title: Reactions by emoji
panels.description: In the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Week's bests taken, by game
panels.description: A round that took the week's best multiplier on its game from another player, from 10x up. Games where it never happens have nobody chasing them.

panels.title: Extras: gamble, rewards claimed, games in progress
Gamble
panels.description: Red or black after a win. A fair bet: the net should wander around zero.

panels.title: Games in progress
panels.description: Mines fields, hands, climbs and runs waiting for a player.

panels.title: Replays kept
panels.description: Rounds big enough for the live feed, kept to be watched again.
